(2) Major national dental/vision carriers and the senior-marketed direct-to-consumer brands (AARP Dental, AARP Vision, Physicians Mutual, Spirit/Denali via Ameritas, Humana, Mutual of Omaha, Cigna). (3) Largest DSOs by office count (Heartland, Aspen, PDS, Smile Brands, Affordable Care, Dental Care Alliance, Western/Sonrava, Great Expressions, Mortenson, Coast, Midwest, 42 North, Tend, Dental365). Most insurers keep premium payment, autopay and statement history behind member logins, so public 'how-to' pages exist only for some (Delta Dental of California, AARP Dental, Humana, Anthem, Aspen, Coast, Great Expressions, Midwest, MyEyeDr., HearingLife, UHC Hearing). Key finding: individual & family plans for many Delta companies (WA, CO, VA, IL, MA, MO/SC, ME/NH/VT and others) are sold and billed through DeltaDentalCoversMe.com, run by Delta Dental of Wisconsin's Wyssta Services. Pay online or by autopay in the CoversMe account, by phone at 888-899-3734, or by mail to P.O. Box 1237, Wisconsin Rapids, WI 54495. Tennessee individual plans are administered by Morgan-White; Idaho, South Dakota, North Carolina and Arizona individual premium rules were read from each company's own FAQ.
